scientific_intent.scientific_task: Normalize groups of image-like tensor channels with per-channel affine parameters, and compute input/weight/bias gradients.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: NCHW B4,C32,H16,W16,G8;4 consecutive channels and1024 scalars/group,32 independent groups; channel gradients sum over batches/spatial sites.
invariants: Group population variance uses denominator1024, not unbiased1023.
Means/rstd shared by four consecutive channels; affine parameters remain per-channel.
Backward analytic gradients agree with independent centered finite differences for8 selected input elements.
accuracy_requirements: Every forward checks32768 outputs+32means+32rstd; backward checks32768dx+32dweight+32dbias,32832 values eachtrial.
Independent Float64 mathematical formulas and8 centeredfinite differences, allstrictatol1e-3; originalout/dweight/dbias1e-2 anddx1.0 are also satisfied.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Uncentered moments and Float32 reduction/rsqrt lowering, atomic channel-gradient order acrossB4; large offsets/tiny variance can amplify cancellation and are not tested.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Fixed group1024,32blocks1024threads; forward/forward2 each10 repeatedoverwrite operations, backward1 complete operation pertrial to prevent ambiguous repeated atomicgradient accumulation.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Source explicitly relates to llm.c normalization and image-channel grouping; operator is training/inference tensor normalization, not an identified model/scientific dataset.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No full neural model, physical data, optimization trajectory or application-level scientific validation established.
